Woh Ladki - Reimagined by Javed–Mohsin, featuring vocals by Dev Negi and Hansika Pareek, with lyrics by Kunaal Vermaa.
Woh Ladki – Reimagined (Official Song) is a heartfelt recreation of the iconic song “Woh Ladki Bahut Yaad Aati Hai” from the film Qayamat: City Under Threat. A song that once defined heartbreak, longing, and timeless love returns today in a new musical form—while keeping its soul intact.
